headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.freshPrefixDraw_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype D] [inst_2 : DecidableEq X]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq D] {A W : ℕ} (k : X → ℕ) (hk : ∀ (x : X), k x ≤ W) (f : (Fin A → Bool) → X)
  (g : (x : X) → (Fin (k x) → Bool) → D),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.freshPrefixDraw k hk f g) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw f) fun x =>
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw (g x)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit W : ℕ)
  (hW :
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.balancedExitWidth r c U L hr hc b J hExit ≤ W),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWord r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit W hW) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledJoinedWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t W : ℕ)
        (hW :
          ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L),
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.balancedExitWidth r c U L hr hc b
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t) ≤
              W),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWord r c U L hr hc d (t + 2) (t + 2)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t) W
                hW))
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp d) ≤
          Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
